name: @app-patterns/vault-files
description: File safety for apps whose content is a folder of files: guarded create and rewrite, external-change guard, watcher router, cloud conflict copies, folder availability and marker files.

scripts.build:js: bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm --packages external
scripts.build: bun run build:js && bun run build:types
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
